name: GHOST-HAND
tagline: A modular Telegram-controlled Windows administration and automation bot with system monitoring, file transfer, and guarded remote actions.
description: GHOST-HAND is a Python-based remote administration tool designed to manage a Windows machine through a Telegram bot. It uses a modular handler architecture and Telegram Bot API long polling, with administrator ID allow-listing and confirmation guards for sensitive actions. The README describes features for system maintenance, resource monitoring, file transfers, power controls, screenshot capture, and RAM optimization.
problemStatement: Users may need to administer and monitor their own Windows machines remotely without opening inbound network ports or relying on traditional remote desktop software.
solution: A Telegram bot that relays commands through Telegram's Bot API using long polling, with administrator ID checks and confirmation guards before sensitive system operations.

features.name: Bidirectional file transfer
details: Upload files from the PC to Telegram
Download Telegram documents to local storage

features.name: Screenshot capture
features.details: Captures screenshots of the controlled Windows machine.

features.name: RAM optimization
features.details: Uses Python garbage collection and Windows API integrations for memory-related operations.

variables.name: BOT_TOKEN
variables.description: Telegram bot token. Keep it secret.

variables.name: ADMIN_IDS
variables.description: Telegram user IDs allowed to administer the bot.

configuration.note: The README says to rename .env.example to .env and configure the bot token and administrator IDs.

installation: Rename .env.example to .env and set BOT_TOKEN and ADMIN_IDS
usage: Open the Telegram bot and send /start

license.details: The README states that the project is distributed under the MIT License.

disclaimer: The README describes the tool as intended for educational, research, and personal administration purposes. Users are responsible for complying with privacy laws and protecting the Telegram bot token.
securityNotes: Only configure administrator IDs for trusted users.
Keep BOT_TOKEN private and do not commit real credentials.
Use remote screenshot and file-transfer features only on machines you own or are explicitly authorized to administer.
The README mentions background and hidden launching; deployments should be transparent to the device owner and should not be used for covert access.
